title: livingproof-verification-refusal/0.1
description: A pre-grade refusal written instead of verification.json. status is REFUSED, code is integrity, schema or vocabulary, and sentence is one sentence (it ends with a period and contains no newline). actual_digest is present only when a file was read. This schema lives with the capability-verifier emitter until step 4 of livingproof-verification#100 moves it into robot-capability-specs.
